# Policymaker #694, iteration 0152

Trigger: 3 iterations without progress. Record 0152 failed with "stalled; policy/ rolled back" (`.session/history/records/0152.json`).

## What I found
- The ledger task ran two times: #689 in 0150 and #692 in 0151. Both ended `partial` with cause `input_budget` (`.session/history/records/0150.json`, `0151.json`).
- Claude `cache_write` was 803,586 and 815,101, near the 800k input budget. Neither session uploaded artifacts.
- The shaper resumed the same full scope. Thus the second session also used too much input.
- Saved work exists at branch `task/692`, commit `fd52cac4`. `benchmark/baseline/attempt-ledger-0150.md` has 10,678 bytes and 10 headings. The `.json` file has 36,816 bytes and parses.
- I did not check these files against the acceptance items. Nobody reviewed the design, and it is not accepted.

## What changed
- `execution/roles/orchestrator/SKILL.md`: I added an `input_budget` rule after "Resume saved work". The shaper inspects the saved branch with `git show`. If the outputs look complete, it orders a finishing-only task: `start_branch`, at most 20 turns, targeted `Edit` fixes only. If they are not complete, it splits the task by file. It never resumes the same full task a third time.
- Expected gain: the ledger supplement finishes in one bounded session, without a third stop at about 800k input.
- Check: the next record has a task with `start_branch: task/692` and `max_turns` ≤ 20 (or a split), and that task ends `done` without `input_budget`.
- `policy/working-memory.md`: I added a section for this session.
- `.session/orders.json` is `{"wake": false, "tasks": []}`. I made no Owner request and no change to routing, params or the evaluator. The "providers unavailable" pauses are external quota state. They give no evidence for a routing change.

Benchmark readiness is false. Product quality is not measured. Whole-method review and owner acceptance are still missing.

## What next
- The next shaper reads `task/692` and orders the finishing task. Then it orders a separate changed-scope review.
- Do not repeat the #685 policy review or the recovery audit. Do not resume the full ledger task again.

Waiting for the iteration to continue: then `policy/` merges and the orders start.
